texts.title_text: Duane Davis convicted of Tupac Shakur's murder after 27 years
texts.slide_1_text: A jury found Duane 'Keffe D' Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur.
texts.slide_2_text: Prosecutors argued Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed Shakur in Las Vegas, Nevada.
texts.slide_3_text: Davis claimed he was merely a witness, but evidence showed he directed the attack from a white Cadillac.
texts.slide_4_text: Shakur's sister Sekyiwa 'Set' Shakur praised the verdict, calling it a long-awaited closure.
